message.content: Li Hua expresses a positive sentiment towards the Blood and Wine expansion, describing it as "incredible" and highlighting the beauty of the new area, Toussaint. She emphasizes that the story feels like a mini-epic and appreciates how it incorporates the surrounding beauty, making the quests feel immersive. Li Hua further comments on the unique atmosphere and the memorable characters of the expansion, indicating that she thoroughly enjoys exploring the new setting.
